description: UNCTADstat is the statistical data centre of UN Trade and Development, and its maritime and other transport theme provides statistics on the merchant fleet, freight volume carried by sea and liner shipping connectivity, with maritime country profiles alongside the general country profiles and a trade and transport exploration tool. All indicators in the data centre are compiled by UNCTAD's Statistics Service under common rules to keep datasets comparable, and a release calendar announces updates. Coverage is global, by country and economy. Access: free through the UNCTADstat data centre, which is a JavaScript application; the site footer links terms of use under Creative Commons. Caveats: the data centre pages could not be read without a browser, so the exact indicator lists and file formats were not checked here, and national totals do not describe individual ports. It supports global maritime network and trade flow analysis, port and shipping capacity baselines and disruption studies of shipping connectivity, and complements the UK port congestion scores catalogued here.
